channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Sergey Brin has spent $100 million opposing California's billionaire tax; he could owe $13 billion if it passes
item.description: Other wealthy Californians, including Larry Page and Peter Thiel, have also donated to fight the wealth tax.

item.title: Jamie Dimon: U.S. dollar's reserve status depends on military strength
item.description: The JPMorgan CEO said without a strong military in 25 years, the dollar may lose its reserve currency status.

item.title: Trump's media and crypto firm reports $238 million quarterly loss; sources of losses detailed
item.description: Bitcoin's price decline and merger-related legal costs contributed to the loss, prompting expansion into new ventures.

item.title: How a book that inspired Warren Buffett and a $14,000 side hustle helped billionaire Bill Ackman get started as an investor
item.description: Bill Ackman, CEO of Pershing Square Capital Management, credits his start as an investor to working at his father's real estate firm.
